name: Asama Riho
source: Another member of garden club and long time friend of Kotone. She is part of what she calls new money, her father being successful business man dealing with computers. Making her a little bit of outsider and not the traditional rich girl. While her outfit fits her flirty personality in actuality the school uniforms are just too small for her chest. Likes to spend her time in nurses office asking her questions and learning about sex, making her more knowledge able than rest of the girls.
